verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at git.cafe/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the forge. The docs also give each repository its own /<owner>/<repo>/llms.txt and state that every guide and most repository pages can be read as Markdown for coding agents. A dedicated agent-workflows guide rounds this out. Missing for 10: the docs index is not served as Markdown (/docs.md returns 404), and there is no independent hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs.
